scope.what: Installed-agent routing sentences ('when to pick this agent') served to the card and destination pickers; the registry's single description field, also what search embeds

findings.current: "Quyết định xây thế nào…" / "Kiểm tra vẻ ngoài…" / "Rà soát trải nghiệm người dùng…"
findings.problem: All three sidecars make the capitalised word a load-bearing device ('HOW' vs the designer's 'LOOKS' vs the ux_reviewer's 'EXPERIENCE'; architect note: 'keep the emphasis', designer: 'keep the emphasis', ux_reviewer: 'keep both'). vi drops the device in all three, so the deliberate three-way contrast between the cards is carried only by the verbs. All-caps Vietnamese would read as shouting and is not this guide's register, so the loss is a style loss, not a meaning loss.
findings.suggestion: Carry the contrast lexically and front it: architect "Quyết định CÁCH xây…" is shouty — prefer "Quyết định trước cách xây…" with 'cách xây' fronted; designer "Xét vẻ ngoài…" vs ux_reviewer "Xét trải nghiệm…" (matched verb pair makes the contrast explicit). Record the device in the vi guide if adopted.

findings.problem: Without the relativiser the run momentarily parses as 'chữ sản phẩm' (the product's writing) before 'người dùng thấy' attaches; the same string later writes user-visible text as 'chữ người dùng thấy', so the two spellings of one concept sit 60 characters apart on a card line read at a glance. Same compound the sibling descriptions audit flagged (V-M1).
findings.suggestion: "câu chữ trong sản phẩm mà người dùng thấy" — and use "câu chữ người dùng thấy" for the later 'Use on user-visible text' clause so one concept has one spelling.

findings.problem: 'saved assets' covers files AND artefacts (the sidecar says so explicitly); 'tệp' narrows the card to files only.
findings.suggestion: "tài nguyên đã lưu" (or "tệp và hiện vật đã lưu").

findings.problem: 'status dashboards' renders as 'status table/board'; vi keeps 'dashboard' or uses 'bảng điều khiển', and this agent's own subject is terminal dashboards, so the weaker compound undersells the artefact.
findings.suggestion: "bảng điều khiển trạng thái" or keep "dashboard" as the kept-English term.

findings.current: "công việc nhiều phần" / "thúc đẩy việc đang bị chặn"
findings.problem: 'multi-part work' is a literal calque ('công việc nhiều phần' reads as 'work, many parts'); 'chasing what is blocked' takes 'thúc đẩy' (push forward), where the sense is chasing up stalled work.
findings.suggestion: "công việc gồm nhiều phần" and "đôn đốc những việc đang bị chặn".
